objective: Quantify theoretical signed-output and above-one event probabilities from Film Damage Flicker driven by a standard-normal sample, across supported control values and representative tones.

scope.effect: FilmDamageCPUImpl flickerGain=1+normal(rng)*flicker; RGB source values are multiplied by gain before overlay; alpha is restored unchanged. Other controls are zero.
scope.method: Offline analytic Gaussian CDF model; do not execute or emulate std::mt19937 / std::normal_distribution sequences. Use tone values [0,.01,.02,.05,.18,.5,.9,.98,1] and controls [0,.08,.25,.5,1].
excluded: exact standard-library RNG sequence or platform-specific draw histogram
temporal frame correlation or perceptual flicker acceptance
grain, dust, scratch, weave, burn interactions

comparison.baseline: flicker=0, gain=1; analytic identity reference, not a visual quality target.
candidates: raw signed RGB before downstream operations
comparison.ground_truth: No image-quality ground truth. Standard-normal probabilities follow the explicit normal model; exact runtime draw outcomes are unknown.
comparison.acceptance: Descriptive probability only. Verify formula, zero-control behavior, monotonic event behavior and Gaussian tail calculations. Do not call probabilities actual product frame frequencies or infer viewer-visible severity.

materials.fixture: Synthetic neutral Float32 tone levels, direct numeric [0,1], one channel-equal value per plate; no transfer function.
materials.identity: Record source marker, plan/runner hashes, exact control/tone grid and analytic definitions.

conditions.numeric_domain: Float64 probability calculation, source tones direct numeric [0,1]. No RGB output clamp in source equation.
conditions.equation: For f>0 and Z~N(0,1), G=1+fZ. P(G<0)=Phi(-1/f). For v>0, P(vG<0)=same and P(vG>1)=Q((1/v-1)/f). For f=0 use deterministic identity; strict inequalities apply.
conditions.regions_and_rois: Every pixel in a uniform neutral tone plate; probabilities are per-channel event probabilities, not empirical pixel samples.
metrics: probability any RGB channel crosses a bound for neutral RGB
expected event count per 24 and 120 samples (no independence or observed-count claim)
tail z threshold and stable Gaussian survival calculation
conditions.display: Probability heatmap and curves in percent; logarithmic display for rare events, exact values retained in JSON.

effect_correctness.method: Verify source markers, event formulas, zero-control identity and monotonic behavior.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: Exact agreement with declared Gaussian equations to double precision; no RNG or product parity claim.

image_quality_and_detail.reason: Probability model has no rendered image or accepted visual target.

color_and_alpha.method: Neutral RGB signed/headroom event probabilities; source restores alpha.
color_and_alpha.unverified: Colored materials, premultiplied semantics, real compositor and downstream clamp.

temporal_stability.reason: Marginal probability does not describe sequence correlation, run lengths, repeated seeks or perceived flicker.

evaluation.decision: No quality acceptance, parameter recommendation or implementation approval. Record only distribution-derived risks and runtime evidence still needed.

execution.backend: Python standard library math.erfc and Pillow visualization; offline analytic model.
execution.threshold_policy: No perceptual thresholds; probabilities are descriptive.
execution.reproducibility: Fixed formulas, tone/control grid, source markers, source and runner hashes.
